The sound system the Egyptians actually built was the voice offering (*peret-kheru*, "going forth at the voice"): the carved formula as a record, the living reader as the needle. The first sound in their cosmogony is the benu's cry on the benben; the perch is the pyramidion.

**The two chambers as two grids.** Queen's Chamber (the ka's room, misnamed by medieval Arabs): on the axis over the natural knoll, floor at 21.2 m ≈ H/7 (20.9), shafts sealed at both ends, niche for the statue. Built to stay. King's Chamber: off-axis ~11 m south, floor at 43.0 m where the horizontal section has exactly half the base area, h = H(1 − 1/√2) = 42.9 m; shafts open to the pole and Orion. Built to leave. The Egyptian sevenths grid catches the Queen's Chamber tightly and the King's loosely; √2 the reverse. Two grids, each owning different corners.

The coffer in the King's Chamber has a sliding groove on three sides and three pin holes in its rim; its lid has never been found and no lid fragments are recorded in the chamber or passages. Khafre's coffer lid lies unbroken on the floor of his burial chamber. In the Grotto, at the edge of a hollow dug by treasure hunters after Ma'mun, lies a broken granite fragment with two worked surfaces at right angles and parts of two large drilled holes (Edgar 1910). Petrie recovered a worked granite block from the Descending Passage with a four-inch drill hole through it; the Edgars note two further large granite pieces in the passages, each with a pair of drill holes. **Breath.** Prevailing north wind on the north face, lee suction on the south: ~80 Pa across 120 m of 20 cm duct gives a ~2.5 m/s draft through the King's Chamber. Sun on the south casing adds a solar-chimney term (~8 Pa, ~0.8 m/s), reversing at night. In from the north (imperishable stars), out to the south (Orion). **Khufu's secret, by the cube.** Not an object. He moved himself off the body corner: identity in the load-bearing stone, survival in other people's mouths (every private tomb's formula begins "an offering which the king gives"; offerings reverted down the plateau through his), the two trusted men on either side, the mother at the fixed point, the body in a nameless box by his dynasty's custom. Inverse cell left empty.

**The two chambers as two grids.** Queen's Chamber (the ka's room, misnamed by medieval Arabs): on the axis over the natural knoll, floor at 21.2 m ≈ H/7 (20.9), shafts sealed at both ends, niche for the statue. Built to stay. King's Chamber: off-axis ~11 m south, floor at 43.0 m where the horizontal section has exactly half the base area, h = H(1 − 1/√2) = 42.9 m; shafts open to the pole and Orion. Built to leave. The √2 ladder hₙ = H(1 − 2^(−n/2)): n = −1 lands at −60.7 m ≈ sea level (the mirror / water line), n = 1 at the king's floor, n = 2 at the half-height (73.3 m), near the top of the relieving stack and the Big Void's reported band (50–70 m). The Egyptian sevenths grid catches the Queen's Chamber tightly and the King's loosely; √2 the reverse. Two grids, each owning different corners.

Muon imaging records only the rock above the detector; the 2017 and 2023 surveys placed detectors in the Queen's Chamber and outside at ground level. No ground-penetrating radar has been run in the Subterranean Chamber, and the Grotto's sand-and-gravel fill has never been probed. Vyse deepened the pit in the Subterranean Chamber floor to about 11 m in 1837 and found rock. The blind passage running 16 m south from that chamber ends in rock and has no explanation.

Glass rolling on glyphs (no edge, no driver); temple as bellowing instrument (0.4 % radiation); shaft as trumpet (trumpets are 18th Dynasty); sound opening doors (20 N vs 15 kN; plugs creep down); bird helmet as ear protection; resurrection by a visitor (texts ask for a voice, curse a hand); fear of being too artificial (Osiris, statues, gold tongues: fear was erasure); red paint as blood (hematite, quarry-painted); body ground into stone (the Seth crime); amber (no supply, muons say air); lid lowered from the ceiling (coffer has a sliding groove and pin holes; nine beams all present); lid in the floor (Vyse dug under the coffer, 1837); Snefru as the Sphinx's face or a mistreating father (no text; Sphinx postdates his death under every attribution); Khufu removing the nose (1378 AD, Sa'im al-Dahr); the Sphinx riddle (Greek, ~2,000 years later); magma, oil, gems (Eocene limestone throughout); pyramid as pump, flood retainer, or trap (no water above it; gypsum mortar dissolves; no reversible stone mechanism anywhere in Egypt); built to collapse (the most overbuilt object ever made); magnetism/energy (no anomaly; the 2018 radio-resonance model is theoretical at 200–600 m wavelengths).

**The inversion.** Sphere of radius H centred at the base centre. The centre (ka's chamber, over the unmoved knoll) has no finite image: it inverts to everything outside, which is the ka's "present wherever the name is said". The King's Chamber at r ≈ 46 m inverts to ρ²/r ≈ 470 m out along the same ray: ~320 m above the apex, slightly south, toward the south shaft. Centre = everywhere; the king = one point, up and south. A construction in the cube frame that agrees with the texts and the shaft; not a cause.
